title: Dad's Pillow Dreams Of Someone KNOCKING 🛏️
description:
If you sleep on someone else's pillow here, you dream their dream. My cousin borrowed Grandma's and dreamed crossword clues all night.

I grabbed my dad's by mistake. His dream is a hall, two knocks at the front door, and a voice yelling "Dad?" And he never opens it.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Why does Dad never open the door in his dream? Would you?
